units.source_text: 此后，源氏大将想起了头弁所诵的文句，痛感过去种种非礼之事深可警戒，

en.t: After this, General Genji remembered the words that To no Ben had recited, and felt keenly that his many discourtesies in the past should serve as a deep warning.

units.source_text: 便觉世路险阻，对尚侍胧月夜也很久不敢通信。

en.t: He came to feel that the ways of the world were perilous and obstructed, and for a long time he did not dare to send word even to Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 有一天，秋雨初降，气象萧索。

en.t: One day, the first autumn rain began to fall, and the whole scene took on a desolate air.

units.source_text: 不知胧月夜有何感想，忽然寄了一首诗来：

en.t: Whether Oborozukiyo was moved by some feeling or another, she suddenly sent him a poem:
